name: Ishmael (son of Nethaniah)
title: Royal descendant who killed Gedaliah
summary: Ishmael, son of Nethaniah, was of royal descent and orchestrated the murder of the governor Gedaliah in Mizpah after the fall of Jerusalem. Incited by Baalis, king of the Ammonites, he also killed a group of pilgrims before fleeing to the Ammonites.

keyEvents.title: Kills Governor Gedaliah
keyEvents.description: Ishmael came to Mizpah and killed Gedaliah, whom the Babylonians had appointed over the land, along with the Jews and Chaldeans who were with him.
